toegepas.blok: Die vuur maak sy eie hitte
toegepas.voor: die vuurhoutjie heeltyd by te hou
toegepas.na: die vuurhoutjie heeltyd by die hout te hou
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'bythou' reads as the separable verb 'byhou' (keep up with); naming what the match is held to makes the meaning clear without adding content.
toegepas.fout: 'by te hou' without an object reads as the separable verb 'byhou' (keep up with), so the sentence stumbles on a first reading.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the wood the match is held to removes the misreading without adding content; 'die hout' is already the referent of the paragraph.

toegepas.blok: Die vuur maak sy eie hitte
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb ('Water ... vat ... weg' and 'die vuur gaan dood'); the protected wording stays intact.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Water ... vat ... weg' and 'die vuur gaan dood' are two full clauses, so AWS 2017 requires the comma; the protected 'die brandende hout se hitte' stays intact.

toegepas.voor: vat die hitte weg en 'n glas
toegepas.na: vat die hitte weg, en 'n glas
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Water ... vat die hitte weg' and ''n glas ... hou die lug weg' are two full clauses joined by 'en', so the comma is required.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: In the sense of reaching something, the idiom is 'by iets kom'; 'bykom' on its own means to regain consciousness.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'bykom' does mean to reach or get at in Afrikaans, so 'waar klein kinders nie kan bykom nie' is correct, and 'waar ... daarby' in the proposal is clumsier.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A plug goes 'in' a wall socket; 'by' is the wrong preposition here.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'by een muurprop' covers plugs connected at one socket through adapters, which is how a socket is overloaded; 'in' narrows that to what fits into the socket itself, so the preposition swap is not proved meaning-neutral.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat om te doen tydens 'n brand
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'totdat' is the standard conjunction before a clause; 'tot' is a preposition.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'tot' is an accepted Afrikaans conjunction before a clause ('rol tot die vlamme dood is'), and the sentence is a safety instruction that already reads well.

na_skrywer.blok: Wat om te doen tydens 'n brand
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The inverted condition can be read by a Grade 5 learner as the order 'burn your clothes'; an explicit 'as' clause keeps the same meaning and removes the misreading.
na_skrywer.fout: The inverted condition 'Brand jou klere, staan stil' can be read by a Grade 5 learner as the order 'burn your clothes'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The misreading is real, but this is a safety instruction in the fire-drill list, so the writer owns the fix.
